technical_debt.title: Decide how to present the technology stack in the Russian interface
scope: Review the current rule that hides technology labels in Russian mode while retaining curated technology data and English-mode display.
Consider Russian explanations or an explicitly approved set of standard technology names without weakening the Russian-language requirement.
Keep repository links limited to verified public repositories; do not invent or add unverified frameworks.
acceptance_criteria: The language policy for technology names is explicitly approved before implementation.
Only verified project technologies are shown, and private repositories remain undisclosed.

technical_debt.title: Localize the location label in English mode
scope: Replace the Russian location label in the English dictionary with its English equivalent.
Check the full location block in both languages after switching.
acceptance_criteria: The English location block contains no Russian label text.
The Russian location block remains unchanged.

technical_debt.title: Align the Russian and English Herbarium AI descriptions
scope: Describe DeepSeek as optional in both languages and state that manual construction and PDF export work without an API key.
Keep both descriptions consistent without claiming that the product itself creates AI systems.
acceptance_criteria: Russian and English descriptions communicate the same product capabilities and optional AI role.

technical_debt.title: Make the generated fallback registry loadable
scope: Resolve the mismatch between the fallback loader's fallback_updated_at requirement and the generated fallback JSON contract.
Preserve README as the canonical source and keep the primary and fallback project arrays synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: With the primary file unavailable and no local cache, the fallback registry renders the project catalog.
The fallback availability status displays a valid source date or does not require a missing date field.

technical_debt.title: Keep internal technical-debt notes out of public runtime data
scope: Separate the README's canonical internal backlog from the public project data emitted for the website.
Update the generator contract so runtime project records contain only data required by the public interface.
acceptance_criteria: The website continues to load the complete public project catalog without a technical_debt field.
Internal backlog entries remain available in the local canonical README and are absent from deployed JSON files.

technical_debt.title: Remove obsolete styles and consolidate repeated rules
scope: Remove selectors left unused after the chat widget removal and obsolete hero or demo elements.
Consolidate repeated project-card rules and repeated language-dictionary overrides without changing approved visuals or behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No removed widget or unused markup styles remain in the public stylesheet.
Project card appearance and approved desktop and mobile interactions remain unchanged.

technical_debt.title: Limit catalog search rendering to the catalog
scope: Avoid rebuilding featured cards for catalog-only search input when their data has not changed.
acceptance_criteria: Typing in catalog search does not re-render the featured showcase.
